articles.title: After Sela Pass, Traffic Congestion Reported at Bumla Pass

articles.title: Friday taken away: Uttarakhand ends Madrasas' Jumu'ah holiday, forces Sunday break
articles.summary: Uttarakhand has scrapped the Friday holiday at recognised madrasas and moved their weekly break to Sunday, a step critics see as targeting minority institutions after the state abolished its Madrasa Board. Uttarakhand has ended the long-standing Friday holiday at madrasas recognised as schools, replacing it with the regular Sunday weekly break under a new framework for minority educational institutions.

articles.title: Mission Shakti: How UP is expanding women's safety network
articles.summary: Uttar Pradesh's Mission Shakti has grown from a Navratri-linked awareness campaign launched in October 2020 into a wider programme covering police stations, public spaces, educational institutions, urban areas and villages across the state. articles.title: Assam girl allegedly abducted from South Kamrup rescued in Tamil Nadu, man arrested

articles.title: Australian teen charged with hate crime after threatening Indian family in Brisbane

articles.title: Trump's green card curbs test Indian tech workers' American dream
articles.summary: Earlier this month, the US announced it would suspend eight technology firms , including Microsoft, India's Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services, Wipro and HCL Technologies, from hiring skilled international workers on a permanent basis through a widely used visa pathway. articles.title: Sensex Jumps Over 1,100 Points as Finance Minister’s Tax Comments Lift Indian Markets
articles.summary: MUMBAI — Indian stock markets rebounded sharply Tuesday, with the benchmark Sensex gaining more than 1,100 points as investors welcomed Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman’s willingness to discuss changes to key market-related taxes. The Sensex surged 1,109. 10 points, or 1. 54%, to close at 73,033. 78, while the Nifty 50 advanced 358.

articles.title: Haryana beat Madhya Pradesh to win Senior Men Hockey National Championship

articles.title: Govt Launches Nationwide Financial Inclusion Campaign at Panchayat, ULB Levels

articles.title: Pakistan veterans Team withdraws from World Cup after PCB denies permission to Travel
articles.summary: The Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) has said no to its over-50s cricket team playing in the International Masters Cricket World Cup in India next January. The team wanted to take part in the tournament, but the board has not given them permission to travel to India. The PCB has also told the Pakistan Veterans Cricket Association about its decision.

articles.title: Houses torched in an abandoned village in Manipur's Kamjong
articles.summary: Tensions have escalated in Kamjong district, Manipur, following the burning of Khoikai Kuki village by suspected militants. More than 50 individuals have lost their lives due to ongoing ethnic clashes between the Kuki and Naga communities since early this year. Manipur's Director General of Police Mukesh Singh visited the district to enhance security coordination among forces addressing the unrest.

articles.title: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio Dismisses Protests in India as Internal Affair
articles.summary: United States Secretary of State Marco Rubio declined to comment on recent protests against the Election Commission during his official visit to India on Wednesday. articles.title: Great Indian Bustard chick killed by fox days after release in Rajasthan; rewilding
articles.summary: JAIPUR: A six-month-old male Great Indian Bustard (GIB) was killed by a fox just four days after being released into the wild at Desert National Park in Rajasthan’s Jaisalmer district on October 14. articles.title: Indian Railways links Chhattisgarh’s Rowghat to national network for first time since
articles.summary: Indian Railways has connected Rowghat in Chhattisgarh to the national rail network for the first time since Independence. Chief Minister Vishnu Deo Sai flagged off two new passenger services Rowghat-Raipur and Raipur-Kurud as the Tadoki-Rowghat and Abhanpur-Kurud rail sections were inaugurated. Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw also outlined plans to expand connectivity towards Rowghat, Jagdalpur and Visakhapatnam.

articles.title: Farmers Group Warns Modi Government Over Proposed United States Trade Deal
articles.summary: The All India Kisan Sabha warned the government of militant resistance on Wednesday if it proceeds with a proposed trade pact with the United States. The farmers organization claims the agreement threatens domestic agriculture, dairy producers, and rural sectors by exposing them to heavily subsidized foreign competition. articles.title_hinglish: massimo datti ne chandigadha men neksasa elante men naya stora khola

articles.title: ‘US relationship with Pak will never come at expense of India ties,’ says Marco
articles.summary: He said his India visits, America’s commitment to the trade deal with New Delhi and their engagements are evidence of the relations. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has said that Washington’s relationship with Pakistan or any other country “will never come at the expense” of its ties with India.

articles.title: Mitchell Santner wary of Bhuvneshwar Kumar threat in T20I series: He will love it
articles.summary: Mitchell Santner believes Bhuvneshwar Kumar could pose a massive threat to New Zealand in the upcoming T20I series against India. Bhuvneshwar made his international comeback after four years when he was named in India’s squad for the series against the Black Caps. He was subsequently added to the squad for the final T20I against the West Indies in Bengaluru .

articles.title: Kuki-Zo Women's Forum Seeks President's Rule in Manipur
articles.summary: The Kuki-Zo Women's Forum on Wednesday demanded the reimposition of President's Rule in Manipur, arguing that the ongoing conflict is a political issue rather than a security matter. articles.title: India’s Space Startups Drive a $40 Billion Industry Ambition
articles.summary: Reforms introduced in 2020, followed by the Indian Space Policy 2023, have helped expand the startup ecosystem to more than 400 companies, according to the source report. The government has established the Indian National Space Promotion and Authorisation Centre (IN-SPACe) as a single-window agency to authorise private space activities and facilitate access to Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) facilities.

articles.title: Nagaland CM Neiphiu Rio calls for inclusive solution to naga political issue

articles.summary_hi: केंद्रीय संस्कृति एवं पर्यटन मंत्री गजेंद्र सिंह शेखावत और संस्कृति मंत्रालय के सचिव विवेक अग्रवाल भी मौजूद रहे। थोराट को उनकी ऑयल पेंटिंग अनटाइटल्ड- II के लिए, शिंगडे को उनके मिश्रित-मीडिया कार्य ट्रीज़ के लिए, और देवस्कर को उनके प्रिंटमेकिंग कार्य ऑफ़ टाइम एंड द सिटी के लिए पुरस्कार मिला। प्रदर्शनी में 27 राज्यों और केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों के 2,495 कलाकारों से 6,175 कलाकृतियाँ प्राप्त हुईं।
articles.title_hinglish: maharashtra ke tina kalakaron ne lalita kala akadami rashtriya puraskara jite
articles.summary_hinglish: kendriya sanskriti evan paryatana mantri gajendra sinha shekhavata aura sanskriti mantralaya ke sachiva viveka agravala bhi maujuda rahe। thorata ko unaki ऑyala pentinga anataitalda- II ke lie, shingade ko unake mishrita-midiya karya trija ke lie, aura devaskara ko unake printamekinga karya ऑpha taima enda da siti ke lie puraskara mila। pradarshani men 27 rajyon aura kendra shasita pradeshon ke 2,495 kalakaron se 6,175 kalakritiyan prapta hueen।
